candidate_order: Rotate by query and reverse on repeat two; retain every run.
common_packer: Same installed context engine, project settings and fixture for both rankers.
session_state: Fresh empty session for every query/candidate/repeat; no stored memories.
caches: Shared warm operating-system/SQLite caches, no flush or cold-cache claim.
timing: Current-process CPU and wall time, search and context separately; no model calls.
percentile: Nearest-rank p95 over retained successful observations; median p50.
context_size: Measured compact UTF-8 JSON bytes and engine planning estimate; not model usage.
complete_body: Union of returned source intervals must contain every expected line, and each line must match the immutable fixture. A symbol name or graph reference is insufficient.
required_dependencies: Two direct helper implementations required by each primary body; imports, runtime/library semantics and transitive type declarations are outside this declared completeness judgment.
precision: Unique returned source files in required or optional-positive paths divided by all returned source files. Exhaustive judgments apply only to this designed fixture task scope; an unjudged file is not automatically irrelevant in a real coding task.
selection: All three policies are eligible. Production ranking selection uses development evidence before this evaluation; the procedural holdout validates the frozen choice and is not used for tuning. Report every body/dependency failure and precision/size/timing tradeoff.
source_safety: Write/read/parse fixture text only; never execute, import or test indexed source.
